Exported Functions

group Mesh_Prov_Provisioner_Exported_Functions

Functions for operating the mesh provisioner.

Functions

bool prov_invite(uint8_t attn_dur)

Start the provisioning process.

The function shall be called at the appropriate timing within the provisioning flow.

Parameters:

attn_dur -- [in] Attention duration in seconds.

Return values:

  • true -- If provisioning started successfully.

  • false -- If provisioning failed to start; validate timing and parameters for recovery.

Returns:

Operation result.

uint16_t prov_assign(int16_t idx, uint16_t addr)

Assign the index and address to a new device during provisioning.

Can be called after prov_invite and before prov_send_prov_data, typically handled during PROV_CB_TYPE_PATH_CHOOSE. Uses default indexing and address assignment unless specified.

Parameters:

  • idx -- [in] Entry index for the device; < 0 denotes default scheme.

  • addr -- [in] Address for the device; 0 denotes default scheme.

Returns:

Assigned index resulting from the operation.

bool prov_assign_net_key_index(uint16_t assign_net_key_index)

Assign the network key index to the new device.

Parameters:

assign_net_key_index -- [in] The key index for network key assignment.

Return values:

  • true -- If network key index was successfully assigned.

  • false -- If assignment failed; ensure the key index is valid for recovery.

Returns:

Operation result.

bool prov_reject(void)

Reject current provisioning attempt.

Stops the ongoing provisioning.

Return values:

  • true -- If provisioning was successfully stopped.

  • false -- If operation failed; validate current provisioning status for recovery.

Returns:

Operation result.

bool prov_unprovisioning(void)

Unprovision a device via pb-gatt.

Deprecated functionality.

Deprecated:

Return values:

  • true -- If device was successfully unprovisioned.

  • false -- If unprovisioning failed; check device constraints and status for recovery.

Returns:

Operation result.

bool prov_path_choose(prov_start_t *pprov_start)

Choose a provisioning path from available options.

Selects public key and authentication data paths based on provided start PDU.

Parameters:

pprov_start -- [in] PDU information to guide selection.

Return values:

  • true -- If path was chosen successfully.

  • false -- If path selection failed; ensure fidelity of start PDU and selected path criteria for recovery.

Returns:

Operation result.

bool prov_device_public_key_set(uint8_t public_key[64])

Set the public key for the provisioning device.

The function should be utilized at an appropriate point in the provisioning process.

Parameters:

public_key -- [in] public key data (64 bytes).

Return values:

  • true -- If public key was set successfully.

  • false -- If setting the public key failed; check the key format and provisioning timing for recovery.

Returns:

Operation result.

bool prov_auth_random_conf_set(uint8_t random[16], uint8_t conf[16])

Set random values and confirmation without providing auth value.

App bypasses auth value provision in stack interaction.

Parameters:

  • random -- [in] Random value used in provisioning (16 bytes).

  • conf -- [in] Confirmation value (16 bytes).

Return values:

  • true -- If values were successfully set.

  • false -- If operation failed; validate value integrity and provisioning status for recovery.

Returns:

Operation result.

bool prov_disconnect_prov(pb_adv_link_close_reason_t reason)

Disconnect the provisioning bearer.

Spec requires disconnection following provisioning procedure. Decision left to app during PROV_CB_TYPE_COMPLETE.

Deprecated:

Parameters:

reason -- [in] Disconnect reason required for pb-adv bearer.

Return values:

  • true -- If bearer was disconnected successfully.

  • false -- If disconnection failed; ensure reason validity and provisioning status for recovery.

Returns:

Operation result.

Operation result.
